Addresses the remaining parsing failures tracked in #524. Runtime labels retain their callbacks and successors; type annotations keep nested type syntax and return runtime delimiters without phantom functions. Contextual `as`/`satisfies` calls, optional fields, templates, runtime operators and generic/import/query types have regression coverage.

Validation:

- Full pytest and `make`: 2,917 passed, 7 existing skips.
- 490 regression cases; independent aggregate refactoring complete.
- All 18 current/cumulative performance comparisons pass; worst paired 95% upper slowdown is 2.7992%, strictly below 3%.

[Qualification details](https://github.com/terryyin/lizard/blob/7fac94f8c5df9c1791b5ef3cf4899847dcaafee1/docs/reviews/issue524-label-types-20261102/QUALIFICATION.md).
